title: False 404 index_not_found_exception from /_cat/indices/ALIAS after master returns

body:
**Elasticsearch version** (`bin/elasticsearch --version`):
```
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM warning: Option UseConcMarkSweepGC was deprecated in version 9.0 and will likely be removed in a future release.

**Plugins installed**: []
```
**JVM version** (`java -version`):
```
openjdk version "13.0.1" 2019-10-15
OpenJDK Runtime Environment AdoptOpenJDK (build 13.0.1+9)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM AdoptOpenJDK (build 13.0.1+9, mixed mode, sharing)
```
**OS version** (`uname -a` if on a Unix-like system):
CentOS Linux release 7.9.2009 (Core)

**Description of the problem including expected versus actual behavior**:

After master node has been down, when it returns there is a brief window where `/_cat/indices/ALIAS` requests are accepted but elasticsearch returns a 404 `index_not_found_exception`. This is unexpected and problematic behavior to our app which considers this an error.

I'd expect a usually strongly consistent system like elasticsearch to return a 503 if it hasn't fully read enough data after master returned to determine if the alias+index exists. It's ok to give an error, it's not okay to give false information like that the index does not exist.

**Steps to reproduce**:
Please include a *minimal* but *complete* recreation of the problem,
including (e.g.) index creation, mappings, settings, query etc.  The easier
you make for us to reproduce it, the more likely that somebody will take the
time to look at it.

 1. For simplicity create a 3 node cluster with one node being the only master and not accepting data.
 2. Create an index with an alias MYALIAS.
 3. Run a curl loop below requesting an index by its alias name to a data node, verify it returns 200.
 4. Stop the master node, the curls soon fail to connect `curl: (7) Failed to connect`.
 5.  Bring the master node back up, it starts  returning `curl: (52) Empty reply from server`
 6. I see one false 404 returned before it goes back to returning a 200 (with a briefly red index).
```
$ while sleep 1 ; do curl -i ELASTICSEARCH:9200/_cat/indices/MYALIAS  ; done
...
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
content-type: application/json; charset=UTF-8
content-length: 437

{"error":{"root_cause":[{"type":"index_not_found_exception","reason":"no such index [MYALIAS]","resource.type":"index_or_alias","resource.id":"MYALIAS","index_uuid":"_na_","index":"MYALIAS"}],"type":"index_not_found_exception","reason":"no such index [MYALIAS]","resource.type":"index_or_alias","resource.id":"MYALIAS","index_uuid":"_na_","index":"MYALIAS"},"status":404}
```

**Provide logs (if relevant)**:

Sorry I can try to recover logs if you can't reproduce this.
